nodes.name: Potion Experimentation
nodes.description: Gain a better understanding of your reagents to improve the likelihood of your experiments yielding satisfying results, gaining +1% increased chance at breakthroughs with Potion Experimentation per point in this specialization.

nodes.name: Phial Experimentation
nodes.description: Gain a better understanding of your reagents to improve the likelihood of your experiments yielding satisfying results, gaining +1% increased chance at breakthroughs with Phial Experimentation per point in this specialization.

nodes.name: Boots
nodes.description: Improve at making leather foot armor, gaining +1 Skill per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Belts
nodes.description: Improve at making leather waist armor, gaining +1 Skill per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Gloves
nodes.description: Improve at making leather gloves, gaining +1 Skill per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Legguards
nodes.description: Improve at making leather leg armor, gaining +1 Skill per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Wristwraps
nodes.description: Improve at making leather wrist armor, gaining +1 Skill per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Shoulderpads
nodes.description: Improve at making leather shoulder armor, gaining +1 Skill per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Helms
nodes.description: Improve at making leather helms, gaining +1 Skill per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Chestpieces
nodes.description: Improve at making leather chest armor, gaining +1 Skill per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Axes, Picks & Polearms
nodes.description: Improve at making axe, picks, and polearms, gaining +1 Crafting Skill per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Maces & Hammers
nodes.description: Improve at making maces and hammers, gaining +1 Crafting Skill per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Long Blades
nodes.description: Improve at making long bladed weapons and tools such as swords, glaives, and sickles, gaining +1 Crafting Skill per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Meat Carver
nodes.description: Improve your ability to harvest meat from certain creatures of the Dragon Isles, gaining a slightly increased chance to find meat while skinning per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Lure Crafter
nodes.description: Hone your skills at gathering usable morsels in the Dragon Isles, gaining a slightly increased chance to find morsels while skinning per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Cloth Collection
nodes.description: Learn to collect cloth more effectively, increasing the amount of cloth found from Humanoids in the Dragon Isles by 1% per point in this Specialization.

nodes.name: Sapphire
nodes.description: Increase your ability to find Stunning Sapphires from Prospecting. You now have a 1% chance to acquire a Stunning Sapphire instead of an Ambivalent Amber when Prospecting per point in this sub-specialization.

nodes.name: Ruby
nodes.description: Increase your ability to find Radiant Rubies from Prospecting. You now have a 1% chance to acquire a Radiant Ruby instead of an Ambivalent Amber when Prospecting per point in this sub-specialization.

nodes.name: Onyx
nodes.description: Increase your ability to find Ostentatious Onyxes from Prospecting. You now have a 1% chance to acquire an Ostentatious Onyx instead of an Ambivalent Amber when Prospecting per point in this sub-specialization.

nodes.name: Emerald
nodes.description: Increase your ability to find Extravagant Emeralds from Prospecting. You now have a 1% chance to acquire an Extravagant Emerald instead of an Ambivalent Amber when Prospecting per point in this sub-specialization.

nodes.name: Textile Treasures
nodes.description: Improve at your Tailoring crafts and learn to collect cloth from humanoids more effectively, gaining increased chance for all cloth to drop in Khaz Algar by 1% per point in this specialization.

nodes.name: Fabric Specialist
nodes.description: Gain +1% drop chance to find cloth in Midnight zones for every point in this specialization.

nodes.name: Thorium Thresher
nodes.description: Learn the telltale signs of gems hiding within Dazzling Thorium, enhancing your ability to locate Eversong Diamonds while prospecting it.

nodes.name: Silver Scrapper
nodes.description: Prepare yourself to shine while working with Brilliant Silver, bestowing the ability to find Eversong Diamonds while prospecting it.

nodes.name: Tin-vestigator
nodes.description: Refuse to sleep on the importance of understanding Umbral Tin, granting you the skill to sometimes spot Eversong Diamonds while prospecting it.

nodes.name: Copper Consumer
nodes.description: Understand the patterns and intricacies of Refulgent Copper, learning how to spot Eversong Diamonds hiding within while prospecting it.

nodes.name: Crystal Collector
nodes.description: Improve your understanding of complex Disenchanting rituals, improving the quality of materials you receive when breaking down Epic items.
